text:
vmType: vz
arch: x86_64
images:
    - location: /Users/ctaylor/.cache/colima/caches/5bfdf1067a8e288910a570fb8c6edbb2340ab7bbc09d2133d64ced3c888a78ed
      arch: x86_64
cpus: 2
memory: 3072MiB
disk: 8GiB
additionalDisks:
    - name: colima-cq-boundary-s5
      format: true
      fsType: ext4
mountType: virtiofs
ssh:
    loadDotSSHPubKeys: false
    forwardAgent: false
containerd:
    system: false
    user: false
dns: []
firmware:
    legacyBIOS: false
hostResolver:
    enabled: true
    hosts:
        host.docker.internal: host.lima.internal
portForwards:
    - guestPortRange:
        - 0
        - 0
      guestSocket: /var/run/docker.sock
      hostPortRange:
        - 0
        - 0
      hostSocket: /Users/ctaylor/.colima/cq-boundary-s5/docker.sock
      proto: tcp
    - guestPortRange:
        - 0
        - 0
      guestSocket: /var/run/containerd/containerd.sock
      hostPortRange:
        - 0
        - 0
      hostSocket: /Users/ctaylor/.colima/cq-boundary-s5/containerd.sock
      proto: tcp
    - guestIP: 0.0.0.0
      guestPortRange:
        - 0
        - 0
      hostPortRange:
        - 0
        - 0
      proto: any
      ignore: true
networks:
    - lima: user-v2
provision:
    - mode: system
      script: sysctl -w fs.inotify.max_user_watches=1048576
    - mode: dependency
      script: groupadd -f docker && usermod -aG docker {{ .User }}
    - mode: system
      script: grep '127.0.0.1 colima-cq-boundary-s5' /etc/hosts || echo '127.0.0.1 colima-cq-boundary-s5' >> /etc/hosts
    - mode: system
      script: hostnamectl set-hostname colima-cq-boundary-s5
    - mode: system
      script: mount -a
    - mode: system
      script: readlink /usr/sbin/fstrim || fstrim -a
    - mode: system
      script: resize2fs /dev/disk/by-label/lima-colima-cq-b || true
    - mode: dependency
      script: |
        #!/usr/bin/env sh

        # Steps:
        # 1. Check if directory is already mounted, if yes, skip setup
        # 2. Idenify disk e.g. /dev/vdb or /dev/vdc
        # 3. Format disk with ext4 if not already formatted
        # 4. Label disk with instance id
        # 5. Mount disk

        DISK_LABEL="lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5"
        MOUNT_POINT="/mnt/${DISK_LABEL}"

        # Detect the disk to use e.g. /dev/vdb or /dev/vdc
        DISK="/dev/vdb"
        if df -h /mnt/lima-cidata/ | tail -n +2 | grep '^/dev/vdb'; then
        	DISK="/dev/vdc"
        fi
        DISK_PART="${DISK}1"

        # Check current mount state before touching the disk.
        if findmnt --noheadings --source "$DISK_PART" --target "$MOUNT_POINT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        	echo "Disk already mounted, skipping setup."
        	exit 0
        fi

        if findmnt --noheadings --target "$MOUNT_POINT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        	echo "Unexpected disk at mount point."
        	exit 1
        fi


        echo 'type=83' | sudo sfdisk "$DISK"
        mkfs.ext4 "$DISK_PART"
        e2label "$DISK_PART" "$DISK_LABEL"


        # mount disk
        mkdir -p "$MOUNT_POINT"
        mount "$DISK_PART" "$MOUNT_POINT"
    - mode: dependency
      script: systemctl stop docker.service
    - mode: dependency
      script: systemctl stop containerd.service
    - mode: dependency
      script: '[ -d /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5 ] && mkdir -p /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/docker /var/lib/docker && mount --bind /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/docker /var/lib/docker'
    - mode: dependency
      script: '[ -d /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5 ] && mkdir -p /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/containerd /var/lib/containerd && mount --bind /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/containerd /var/lib/containerd'
    - mode: dependency
      script: '[ -d /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5 ] && mkdir -p /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/rancher /var/lib/rancher && mount --bind /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/rancher /var/lib/rancher'
    - mode: dependency
      script: '[ -d /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5 ] && mkdir -p /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/cni /var/lib/cni && mount --bind /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/cni /var/lib/cni'
    - mode: dependency
      script: '[ -d /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5 ] && mkdir -p /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/ramalama /var/lib/ramalama && mount --bind /mnt/lima-colima-cq-boundary-s5/ramalama /var/lib/ramalama'
